laken_godart.name: Laken Godart

canon_ref.note: From San Francisco; blind from birth. His diary counts days from his own arrival, not Erin's calendar. Level 4 as of 3.01E.

laken_godart.summary: A blind young Earther who steps out of a mall food court into a forest near Riverfarm in north Izril. Calm and wry, he moves in with the shunned Durene, names himself an [Emperor] and gets the class, and makes her his [Paladin].

durene.name: Durene

canon_ref.note: Before 3.01E she was a Level 6 [Farmer] with [Enhanced Strength]. Her mother died when she was four; an adventurer killed her Troll father.

durene.summary: A huge, gentle half-Troll girl who lives alone in her dead mother's cottage outside Riverfarm. The village calls on her strength but keeps her apart and lets its children stone her. She takes in Laken, falls in love with him, and becomes his [Paladin].

prost.name: Prost

canon_ref.note: Married to Yesel. His old plow horse is Evera.

prost.summary: A Riverfarm farmer who first welcomes Laken and relies on Durene's strength, but fears her as a monster. He took her in as a child only at her mother's request, and fled when she finally shouted what she is.

yesel.name: Yesel

canon_ref.note: By village talk she found Durene's mother pregnant and alone, with Troll tracks nearby (3.01E).

yesel.summary: Prost's wife. Polite and generous to Laken with food and winter clothes, cold and bossy to Durene, and eager to move the blind stranger out of the half-Troll's house into the village.

ivolethe.name: Ivolethe

canon_ref.note: Her true name is secret; Ivolethe is what Ryoka may call her. She says she is the faerie Ryoka struck, who warned her of the armies and took the second price of her bargain.

ivolethe.summary: A Frost Faerie of the Winter Court who stays with Ryoka when her sisters grow bored and leave. Sharp-tongued and proud, she becomes Ryoka's friend, bites those who poke her, and offers to teach Ryoka to run like the wind.

geneva_scala.name: Geneva Scala

canon_ref.note: Third-year medical student from Wisconsin, 24. Level 17 is worked out from Level 11 plus six (1.01D). After 1.01D a Selphid, Okasha, lives inside her body and keeps it moving.

geneva_scala.summary: An Earther medical student stranded in Baleros who enlists with a mercenary company as its [Doctor]. With no potions and few tools she operates through a jungle battle, learns triage, treats any side under a red cross, and is called the Last Light.

okasha.name: Okasha

canon_ref.note: Of the Burning March 6th Division. Selphids are parasites that live in and move dead bodies.

okasha.summary: A Selphid soldier whom Geneva moves into a fresh corpse after a spell tears her old host apart. Half paralysed, she becomes Geneva's steady surgical assistant, then enters Geneva's own body to keep her alive.

thriss.name: Thriss

canon_ref.note: Of the 4th Battalion of the Raverian Fighters. Killed by Okasha in 1.01D.

thriss.summary: A loud, armoured [Sergeant] who recruits Geneva and trusts her with the potion key. Pushed by the war and the lost potions, he turns on her for healing an enemy Centaur and breaks her spine before Okasha kills him.

belgrade.name: Belgrade

canon_ref.note: One of the five surviving original Individuals of Erin's chess club (Pawn, Bird, Belgrade, Anand, Garry).

belgrade.summary: A Worker of Liscor's Hive and one of the five original Individuals from Erin's chess club. A growing [Tactician] who leads Antinium against dungeon monsters in the tunnels below the Hive.

anand.name: Anand

canon_ref.note: One of the five surviving original Individuals of Erin's chess club.

anand.summary: A Worker of Liscor's Hive and one of the five original Individuals from Erin's chess club. Like Belgrade, a rising [Tactician] who fights the dungeon's monsters under the city.

garry.name: Garry

canon_ref.note: One of the five surviving original Individuals. He cooks, but his class is not named here.

garry.summary: A Worker of Liscor's Hive and one of the five original Individuals from Erin's chess club. He has taken to cooking, frying the birds Bird shoots into a snack the Hive can stand to eat.

nemor.name: Nemor

canon_ref.note: Race not stated; a man with a narrow face and a goatee. The maids call him Great Mage, which Magnolia scoffs at. Killed by Magnolia in 3.14.

nemor.summary: A vain, gloating mage in yellow and green robes who once cast ward spells for Magnolia Reinhart and was trusted as her guest. He leads a band of [Assassins] against her for the Circle of Thorns, turns her Golems on her, and is burnt to ash by her ring.

frostwing.name: Frostwing

canon_ref.note: Laken and Durene take her for an eagle, but her fuzz is green and her nest was low in a tree, so they are unsure. Female. Bonded to Laken by [Lesser Bond: Frostwing].

frostwing.summary: A big, fierce, meat-hungry chick Laken finds under a fallen nest by Durene's cottage; she ate her nestmates to survive. He names her Frostwing and makes her his subject. She pecks his fingers, shrieks for food and grows fast.

gamel.name: Gamel

canon_ref.note: His father was the village [Blacksmith] and died in the avalanche. He knows a weak flame spell. He dreams of being an adventurer or going to Wistram.

gamel.summary: A young man of Riverfarm whom Laken digs out of the avalanche upside down. He then digs beside Laken all day, calls him Emperor, camps outside Durene's cottage to serve him, and goes with him and Durene to Invrisil.

jasi.name: Jasi

canon_ref.note: A foundling raised by a Human couple, Grev's parents, who later split. Has never left Celum. Moves into the Frenzied Hare in 3.15 (jasi.lives_at_frenzied_hare). Plays Juliet in 3.16.

jasi.summary: A young dark-red Drake who washes clothes for copper in a hut by Celum's walls, her claws scraped raw by the work, and raises her brother Grev alone. Timid, dutiful and grateful. Erin takes her in at the Hare, and she finds she loves the stage.

hess.name: Hess

canon_ref.note: Lives on Springbottom Street and married a Human woman. One of two or three Drakes in Celum. Faints from stage fright before the play. That he plays Tybalt is likely, not stated.

hess.summary: A Drake [Baker] of Celum, one of very few Drakes in the city. Jasi fetches him to fill the Drake roles in Erin's play; he shuts his bakery for the day and joins the cast.

ylawes_byres.name: Ylawes Byres

canon_ref.note: 3.15-3.20T never call them kin; 3.24 does: Yvlon says Ylawes is her older brother, who usually works in the far north near their family estates. Linked by that text. His team has a Dwarf (3.25).

ylawes_byres.summary: A tall blond Gold-rank [Knight] in silver plate, with enchanted sword and shield, who comes alone to burned Esthelm to put its dead to rest. Proud, brave and blunt, he shames its gangs into a city again and holds the barricades until his team, the Silver Swords, arrives.

esthelm_florist.name: The Florist of Esthelm

canon_ref.note: Never named; she forgets her own name. Not linked to any named character. Dies in 3.20T. Her Horror ranks, Conditions, Aspects and level loss are system records (3.17T, 3.20T).

esthelm_florist.summary: A young [Florist] of Esthelm who lost her family when the city burned. Starving, she eats the dead and becomes a wordless, clawed Horror. The Redfang Goblins who save her treat her as a person; she dies defending her people.

goblin_vanguard_commander.name: Goblin vanguard commander

canon_ref.note: Unnamed. Not linked to the Goblin Lord or any named Goblin. Killed by Grunter in 3.20T.

goblin_vanguard_commander.summary: The black-tattooed Goblin who leads the Goblin Lord's vanguard at Esthelm, riding a huge Shield Spider and wielding a gleaming halberd that cuts through armour. Ruthless with his own [Shamans].

goblin_vanguard_head_shaman.name: Goblin vanguard head shaman

canon_ref.note: Unnamed. Sent to lead the vanguard's dead. Killed by Toren in 3.17T.

goblin_vanguard_head_shaman.summary: An old Goblin [Shaman] with a staff of fused ivory bones who rides in a cart and commands the vanguard's undead. His order grips even Toren, but not firmly enough.

grunter.name: Grunter

canon_ref.note: One of the thirteen Redfang warriors Garen sent after Erin. A band nickname; the Redfang have no Shaman to give names. Leads the band. Dies in 3.20T.

grunter.summary: The heavy, grunting Hob who leads the Redfang band, nearly as wide as he is tall and loyal to his Chieftain. He speaks a few Human words. With one arm broken he kills the Goblin Lord's commander at Esthelm and dies.

badarrow.name: Badarrow

canon_ref.note: One of the thirteen Redfang warriors Garen sent after Erin. A band nickname; the Redfang have no Shaman to give names. Survives Esthelm (3.20T).

badarrow.summary: The Redfang band's [Archer], who refuses to touch a badly made arrow and has killed two Silver-rank adventurers. Proud and prickly. At Esthelm he shoots two [Shamans]; a shoddy enemy arrow is what saves his life.

headscratcher.name: Headscratcher

canon_ref.note: One of the thirteen Redfang warriors Garen sent after Erin. A band nickname; the Redfang have no Shaman to give names. Survives Esthelm (3.20T).

headscratcher.summary: A Redfang sword-Goblin named for the ticks in his scalp. It is he who first leaps down to save the Florist and later hugs her. He leads the charge that breaks Toren and holds her as she dies.

bugear.name: Bugear

canon_ref.note: One of the thirteen Redfang warriors Garen sent after Erin. A band nickname; the Redfang have no Shaman to give names. Survives Esthelm (3.20T).

bugear.summary: A Redfang spear-and-shield Goblin named for the mites nesting in his ear, which the Florist washes out. Loyal to Garen at first. A Skill saves him from Ylawes' blow, and he pins Toren's sword arm in the last battle.

rocksoup.name: Rocksoup

canon_ref.note: One of the thirteen Redfang warriors Garen sent after Erin. A band nickname; the Redfang have no Shaman to give names. Dies in 3.20T.

rocksoup.summary: A Redfang warrior who drops a stone in his soup and argues that the tribe should obey Rags. He fights with blade and off-hand dagger and dies at Esthelm taking the zombies' blows meant for Headscratcher.

numbtongue.name: Numbtongue

canon_ref.note: One of the thirteen Redfang warriors Garen sent after Erin. A band nickname; the Redfang have no Shaman to give names. Survives Esthelm (3.20T).

numbtongue.summary: One of the Redfang band's quietest trackers, who scouts ahead with Badarrow through the ruins of Esthelm. He lives through the last battle.

rabbiteater.name: Rabbiteater

canon_ref.note: One of the thirteen Redfang warriors Garen sent after Erin. A band nickname; the Redfang have no Shaman to give names. Survives Esthelm (3.20T).

rabbiteater.summary: A Redfang warrior who keeps watch in Esthelm and stands in the charge on Toren, where a zombie bites him to the bone. Headscratcher helps him away, and he lives.

shorthilt.name: Shorthilt

canon_ref.note: One of the thirteen Redfang warriors Garen sent after Erin. A band nickname; the Redfang have no Shaman to give names. Survives Esthelm (3.20T).

shorthilt.summary: A Redfang warrior who tackles Toren from behind in the last battle and holds on through a kick that breaks his nose, so Headscratcher can cut the skeleton down.

leftstep.name: Leftstep

canon_ref.note: One of the thirteen Redfang warriors Garen sent after Erin. A band nickname; the Redfang have no Shaman to give names. Dies in 3.20T.

leftstep.summary: A Redfang warrior set on watch when the band reaches Esthelm. An arrow through the eye kills him during the charge on Toren.

bitefly.name: Bitefly

canon_ref.note: One of the thirteen Redfang warriors Garen sent after Erin. A band nickname; the Redfang have no Shaman to give names. Dies in 3.20T.

bitefly.summary: A Redfang warrior who takes a night watch in Esthelm and helps hold off Ylawes. A Ghoul drags him down in the charge on Toren.

orangepoo.name: Orangepoo

canon_ref.note: One of the thirteen Redfang warriors Garen sent after Erin. A band nickname; the Redfang have no Shaman to give names. Dies in 3.20T.

orangepoo.summary: An always-grinning Redfang warrior who dies at Esthelm spearing a Goblin's leg to trip a charging group so the others can reach Toren.

patchhelm.name: Patchhelm

canon_ref.note: One of the thirteen Redfang warriors Garen sent after Erin. A band nickname; the Redfang have no Shaman to give names. Dies in 3.20T.

patchhelm.summary: A Redfang warrior beheaded by Toren's blurring blade as the band reaches the skeleton in the last battle.

justrust.name: Justrust

canon_ref.note: One of the thirteen Redfang warriors Garen sent after Erin. A band nickname; the Redfang have no Shaman to give names. Dies in 3.20T.

justrust.summary: A Redfang warrior whose neck a zombie snaps from behind during the band's charge on Toren.

robert.name: Robert

canon_ref.note: Only named, not followed; which painted Soldier he is, if any, is not said. Story role only: no npc_behaviour entry.

robert.summary: One of the wounded Soldiers under Pawn's command, the first Soldier Pawn gives a name. The name changes nothing for him: Soldiers cannot speak it, so it is just another word.

xrn.name: Xrn

canon_ref.note: Leads the delegation. The only living Antinium who can cast spells; Klbkch has known her since he was made. Drakes call her the Small Queen. Class not named. Her eyes shift through many colours.

xrn.summary: Prognugator of the Grand Hive: a slim, short Antinium with an azure shell and a staff, who casts magic. An old friend of Klbkch, sharp-tongued and commanding, she talked the Grand Queen into letting her visit Liscor. In the Antinium Wars she burned a Drake and Human command tent.

tersk.name: Tersk

canon_ref.note: Brings three other Armored Antinium with swords and a spear. He defers to Xrn and Klbkch.

tersk.summary: Prognugator of the Armored Antinium: a big, Soldier-like Antinium with two arms and true hands, clad in fitted steel plate, carrying a shield and mace. Polite and quiet.

pivr.name: Pivr

canon_ref.note: Brings five warriors like himself and one heavy, horned variant. His Queen ordered a show of force at Liscor's gate, over Xrn's head.

pivr.summary: Revalantor of the Flying Antinium: hunched, with two sets of jade wings, four sets of eyes, twin daggers and poison spit. Pompous and tactless, he obeys his Queen over Xrn and leads his fliers into Liscor through the main gate.

ijvani.name: Ijvani

canon_ref.note: Travels with Venitra on Az'kerash's order; her true form is hidden.

ijvani.summary: A servant of Az'kerash who moves like a dark shadow and speaks in a wet whisper. She goes with Venitra to hunt the Runner Ryoka and is the one who asks whether they are lost.

adelynn.name: Adelynn

canon_ref.note: Named in 3.25; the same driver took the Horns from Remendia to Celum in 3.24. The only driver willing to go near Albez.

adelynn.summary: A blunt Merchants' Guild wagon driver who carries the Horns from Remendia to Celum, then drives Pisces and Ksmvr to Albez for the door, pelting Pisces with snow whenever he scares her horses.
